articles.headline: Dream say concerns over finding available WNBA Finals venue went unheeded
articles.description: In a letter to the city, the Atlanta Dream said Game 6 getting moved to 12:30 p.m. so they can play in State Farm Arena was "not what we fought for."

images.credit: Photo by Joe Boatman/NBAE via Getty Images

images.caption: Shelburne: Updated WNBA Finals Game 6 logistics 'the best of bad options'

articles.headline: WNBA Finals odds: Valkyries flip the odds with Game 5 win over Dream
articles.description: After falling to +225, Golden State has rattled off back-to-back wins to become the -260 favorite to win the WNBA Finals.

images.name: Gabby Williams [1296x729]
images.caption: Golden State's Gabby Williams enters Game 6 as the big favorite for WNBA Finals MVP.
images.alt: Gabby Williams #1 and Tiffany Hayes #15 of the Golden State Valkyries react during the first quarter in game five of the 2026 WNBA Finals against the Atlanta Dream at Chase Center on October 26, 2026 in San Francisco, California.

images.name: Gabby Williams [1296x729]
images.caption: Gabby Williams and the Valkyries are slim favorites at home in Game 5.
images.alt: Golden State forward Gabby Williams (1) drives to the basket during Game Four of the WNBA finals between the Golden State Valkyries and the Atlanta Dream on October 24th, 2026 at State Farm Arena in Atlanta, GA.

images.name: Angel Reese [1296x729]
images.caption: Angel Reese enters Game 3 with the second-shortest odds for WNBA Finals MVP, trailing Gabby Williams.
images.alt: Angel Reese #5 of the Atlanta Dream dribbles the ball during the game against the Golden State Valkyries during Game Two of the 2026 WNBA Finals on October 19, 2026 at the Chase Center in San Francisco, CA.

images.name: Gabby Williams [1296x729]
images.caption: Gabby Williams, the Valkyries' marquee acquisition this past offseason, has her team in the championship in only its second season.
images.alt: Gabby Williams #1 of the Golden State Valkyries looks on between plays in the fourth quarter against the Las Vegas Aces during the Semifinals Game One at Chase Center on October 4, 2026 in San Francisco, California.

images.name: Angel Reese [1296x729]
images.caption: Angel Reese and the Dream have moved in front as title favorites after the Game 1 win over the Liberty.
images.alt: Angel Reese #5 of the Atlanta Dream looks on during the game against the New York Liberty during Semi-Finals Game 1 on October 4, 2026 at State Farm Arena at College Park in Atlanta, Georgia

images.name: A'ja Wilson [608x342]
images.caption: A'ja Wilson and the Aces are moving on after eliminating Caitlin Clark and the Fever.
images.alt: A'ja Wilson

images.name: Liberty [1296x729]
images.caption: After sweeping the Lynx in the first round of the WNBA playoffs, the Liberty are the new favorites to win the WNBA Finals.
images.alt: Sabrina Ionescu #20 of the New York Liberty reacts during the second quarter against the Minnesota Lynx during game two of the WNBA Playoffs first round at Barclays Center on September 29, 2026 in the Brooklyn borough of New York City.

images.name: New York Liberty [1296x729]
images.caption: After sweeping the No. 1 Lynx in the first round of the WNBA playoffs, the Liberty are now the favorites to win the title.
images.alt: Breanna Stewart #30 of the New York Liberty and Sabrina Ionescu #20 of the New York Liberty high five during the game against the Minnesota Lynx during Round One Game Two of the 2026 WNBA Playoffs on September 29, 2026 at Barclays Center Arena in Brooklyn

images.name: Olivia Miles [1296x729]
images.caption: Napheesa Collier, Olivia Miles and the Lynx remain big favorites to win the WNBA championship.
images.alt: Olivia Miles #5 of the Minnesota Lynx reacts to a foul call next to Napheesa Collier #24 during WNBA game against the Golden State Valkyries on August 19, 2026 at Chase Center in San Francisco, CA.

images.name: Napheesa Collier [1296x729]
images.caption: Napheesa Collier and the Lynx enter the week at even money to win the WNBA championship.
images.alt: Napheesa Collier #24 of the Minnesota Lynx drives to the basket during the game against the Las Vegas Aces on August 15, 2026 at Michelob ULTRA Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada.

images.name: Napheesa Collier [1296x729]
images.caption: Napheesa Collier, Natasha Howard and the Minnesota Lynx continue to roll.
images.alt: Napheesa Collier #24 of the Minnesota Lynx celebrates with teammate Natasha Howard #1 against the Toronto Tempo during the second half at Scotiabank Arena on July 30, 2026 in Toronto, Canada.

images.name: Napheesa Collier [1296x729]
images.caption: Napheesa Collier's welcome return only boosts a Lynx team that's the current favorite to win the WNBA Finals.
images.alt: Napheesa Collier #24 of the Minnesota Lynx shoots a free throw during the game against the Seattle Storm on July 22, 2026 at Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle, Washington.

images.name: Olivia Miles for Odds File (260720) [1296x729]
images.caption: Rookie of the Year front-runner Olivia Miles is one of the big reasons that the sportsbooks have made the Minnesota Lynx the team to beat for the championship this season.
images.alt: Olivia Miles #5 of the Minnesota Lynx looks on during the game against the Portland Fire on July 18, 2026 at Target Center in Minneapolis, Minnesota.
